issues.description: The problem statement's UML specifies SealSaloon.orderMeal(Meal) with a void return type, but the solution implements orderMeal(Meal) to return boolean. This mismatch in the method return type can confuse students about the expected signature and behavior of orderMeal when they implement the class themselves.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the method signature across artifacts. Either change the solution's orderMeal to return void (removing the boolean return values) to match the UML/specification, or update the problem statement/UML to specify a boolean return type and document its meaning so students know which signature to implement.
